use_cases: Payment success confirmation after money transfer completes
Transaction status display for banking and fintech applications
Animated success feedback in payment processing flows
Onboarding completion indicator for financial apps
Order confirmation with fund transfer animation
ai_summary: A currency transfer animation component that displays an animated checkmark success state with sequentially appearing currency icons. Built with SVG stroke animations, scale transitions, and timed delays to create a polished payment completion experience. Ideal for fintech dashboards, payment confirmations, and transaction status screens requiring visual feedback for successful money transfers.
